actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE new full-body game animation sprite for 09_bamboo_archer_girl, SOUTH facing directly toward the viewer, WALK frame 05 of a 16-frame seamless 480ms cycle. Not a sprite sheet.
Reference image 1 is the exact original identity: preserve this cheerful green-eyed round-faced chibi girl, dark brown long high ponytail, jade bamboo-leaf gold hair clasp, pale yellow-green ribbons, jade earrings, green-and-ivory layered short Taoist tunic, gold leaf embroidery, ivory shorts, green/gold/ivory boots, yin-yang belt buckle and green tassel, bamboo bow and matching quiver. Preserve her exact face, 2.4-head-tall proportions, costume construction and equipment. The quiver is worn on her anatomical RIGHT shoulder, screen LEFT in a front view. Reference image 2 is ONLY the approved painting style and finish: clean bright rounded Chinese fantasy hand-painted volume; no UI, text, backdrop or extra ornaments.
Draw a relaxed traveling WALK, not an archery attack. Carry the ORIGINAL FULL-LENGTH bamboo bow vertically along her left side (screen right), her left elbow bent and grip raised to lower chest height. The bow end-to-end length must remain 80 percent of her full height, top tip near her upper hair, bottom tip near her ankle, with its complete original green segmented bamboo limbs, gold leaf tips and gold central grip. Do not miniaturize the bow. Bowstring relaxed, no nocked arrow. Quiver remains attached on her back. Both short legs and both boots are clearly readable below the tunic.
Pose S05: LEFT leg (screen RIGHT) is planted vertically under the body bearing the weight. RIGHT leg (screen LEFT) is the SWING leg, knee flexed and passing alongside the planted left leg; right boot lifted a little above the ground near the supporting left ankle. Feet near passing position but individually readable; never two feet airborne. Hips level and only subtly higher than contact. This is a genuine one-leg support passing pose, not a wide contact stance.
Fixed camera: orthographic character-sprite view, slightly looking down by about 10 degrees, body yaw exactly SOUTH front. Full figure plus entire bow and quiver, generous safety margin, no cropping. Square native canvas at least 1024x1024, preferably 1536x1536; highest available visual quality. Character from hair ornament to grounded soles occupies about 84 percent of canvas height, body axis at horizontal center, soles baseline at 92 percent height. Production SOURCE matte requirement: an absolutely solid flat opaque pure magenta RGB(255,0,255) background covering every empty pixel, also every enclosed hole between bowstring and bow, hair locks, sleeves and legs. OPAQUE background, not transparent. No checkerboard, no ground shadow, no gradients, no glow. Clean crisp antialiased silhouette. Consistent soft upper-left lighting, crisp clean painted silhouette, fine detailed painting matching the identity. One complete newly drawn pose only; no collage, duplication, mirroring, motion blur, labels or watermark.
STRICT corrections: original full-length bow as specified, clean painted silhouette. Do NOT produce a transparent PNG. This is the opaque MAGENTA production master for subsequent standard project alpha export. No red or yellow fringe, spill or speckles. Keep exact original short-limbed proportions and one figure.
Reference image 3 is the selected SOUTH01 walking master: keep its exact character scale, head/hair volume, fixed camera, face, torso, waist height, long-bow size, bow grip and equipment arrangement. Change only the walking phase, including the actual leg joints, support contact and small natural arm/cloth motion. It must be a genuinely newly drawn different pose. The same character stays on the spot while walking; no horizontal camera translation.
